subject: Contrastive Learning
source_sentence: We use contrastive learning with the InfoNCE loss : exp s(a(i), b(i)) P a exp s(a, b(i)) + exp s(a(i), b(i)) P b exp s(a(i), b), (1) where A, B are two sets of data points from two different modal domains, respectively; a(i), b(i) are vector representations of the co-occuring pair (a(i), b(i)) which are encoded by gA(a(i)) and gB(b(i)), respectively; s(a, b) computes the simi- larity between a and b, which we take to be scaled cosine similarity .
